seo.title: All-inclusive coworking and office rental in Besançon
seo.description: Private offices and open-space desks in central Besançon. All inclusive, no hidden fees. Two addresses: 11 avenue Carnot and 3 rue Granvelle.

hero.text: Private offices and open-space desks in central Besançon. You sign, you drop your things, you get to work. Bills, high-speed internet, cleaning and the meeting room are all in, with no hidden fees.

items.title: You visit
items.text: 20 minutes on site, coffee included. We show you both spaces and the free desks.

items.title: You sign
items.text: A simple service contract, no commercial lease, no admin fees.

items.title: You work
items.text: Badge handed over, internet plugged in, coffee hot. Drop your things and off you go.

band.title: {count} spots left. Not 40.
band.text: A 20-minute viewing, a service contract, and you move in.

items.a: No. The iOiO works with a service contract and a short notice period. You leave when your business changes.

items.q: What is really included in the price?
items.a: Bills, water, electricity, heating, cleaning, high-speed internet, furniture, meeting room, fitted kitchen and coffee. There are no additional fees.

items.q: What is the difference between Carnot and Granvelle?
items.a: Carnot, 11 avenue Carnot, is 4 closed private offices around an inner courtyard, with a meeting room, kitchen, shower and toilets. Granvelle, 3 rue Granvelle, is the coworking space: private offices or dedicated open-space desks, key locker, bar table and sofa corner.
Of course. Carnot has a meeting room with a video projection system; Granvelle has a bar table and a sofa corner for informal meetings.
